name: nonoun-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins: the harness/docs authoring toolchain and the domain plugins (agent-protocols, llm, design, frontend, teamwork, brand-design) plus authorkit's estate governance.

plugins.name: agent-protocols
plugins.description: A2UI knowledge packs — wire protocol/renderer, catalog design, the live conversational agent, and the training corpus — answering how @agent-ui/a2ui works from a cited repo corpus; named agent-protocols (not a2ui) to leave room for future Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol material.

plugins.name: authorkit
plugins.description: Harness artifact governance: naming grammar, frontmatter contracts, folder layout, migration tooling, and busy-work/over-specification audits for .claude/ estates and plugins. Dogfoods its own spec — this plugin validates clean against its own validator with an empty exemptions array.

plugins.name: brand-design
plugins.description: Build and evaluate brands grounded in cultural authority — strategy, identity, voice, and stewardship — across three seats: an aspirational Muse, a maker (methodology + voice), and an adversarial named-critic Council (check-brand-council, fanning out brand-judge dispatches with one persona inlined per call). Migrated and overhauled from the standalone brand-forge plugin; this estate's only MCP/userConfig-registered plugin (brand-corpus MCP, optional per-instance live retrieval).

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: The design plugin — color science and palettes, typography systems, and design-system exports in one install: OKLCH ramps and verification, the 11-voice type system, Material Design token grammar, the DESIGN.md/Figma Make/Google Stitch export bundles a generative design agent consumes, artifact-styling-rules (theme/token/type/mermaid/shell doctrine for Claude Artifacts), and token-feature-intake-rules (visual/token feature-ticket intake schema).

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Functional-document authoring: ADR, PRD, SPEC, LLD, PLAN, ROADMAP, TICKET, TASK, IDR, RDD — standards, maker, review, validator, ten type templates, and file-bug (capture -> classify -> record -> dispatch -> write-back for bug reports). Also covers research/measurement (research-methods, make-rubric), markdown↔markup conversion (markdown-to-markup, html-to-markdown), knowledge/reference authoring (make-reference, make-llms-txt, make-vision-memo — knowledge-pack authoring lives in harness's make-pack), artifact/report-page authoring (make-artifact + artifact-rules — a design system's DESIGN.md/tokens.json (or a synthesized one, or a doctrine-neutral fallback) plus report, handbook, or project-records content into a rendered Artifact page; artifact-rules now carries procedure-side standards only, citing design's artifact-styling-rules for visual doctrine), project-facts (domain-knowledge harvest: discovered topic zones scored two-axis, Outside-In x Inside-Out) and its harness-facts sibling (the same harvest reframed for a coding agent's own harness: install-ready CLAUDE.md-grade entry-file sections, path-scoped rules, pack seeds, dispatch context, weighted Inside-Out x Outside-In), product-lifecycle-rules (the general, portable build-loop/alignment doc doctrine) and check-stage (its live lifecycle-position reading — which loop/build-turn stage a repo is in), and a fresh-context doc-checker agent alongside the experiment-runner agent.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: The foundational authoring plugin, self-contained: maker/standards/lint families for skills, agents, hooks, and entry files; the absorbed language layer (prompt-wording-rules), intent extraction, and two-plane decomposition; /check-everything as the recurring outer loop.

plugins.name: llm
plugins.description: Portable LLM-integration and chat-agent-harness knowledge, project-agnostic: the swappable-provider gateway pattern, streaming structured output over JSONL/SSE, the seven-layer construction of a mini/portable chat-agent harness (instructions/guardrails, skills/routing, orchestration/workflows, knowledge/memory, tools/resources/services, observability, and a deployed runtime's own producer-loop resilience), and the Resident-Agent/Ephemeral-Agent residency taxonomy that keeps CLI-harness and hosted-chatbot findings from conflating. Distilled from @agent-ui/a2ui's live-agent implementation and Claude Code's own current harness mechanics, taught as general technique rather than a repo-specific answer pack.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Design and critique UI structure (layouts, flows, components, patterns), answer motion questions from a cited corpus (motion-rules), verify it all against non-functional bars (focus, i18n, perf, safety), and capture per-shape UI-feature ticket intake schemas (feature-intake-rules) — plus check-ui-change, which drives the live artifact instead of reasoning about it in the abstract.

plugins.name: teamwork
plugins.description: Derive decisions, design composition/continuation patterns, and run a multi-agent feature-delivery team end to end.
